publicationStmt.p: Alternative title is Tales of the Sun, 1855
Electronic reproduction. New York, N.Y.: Columbia University Libraries, 2018.

sourceDesc.p: Original album forms part of the Thomas Carlyle Papers Collection at Columbia University Rare Book and Manuscript Library

div.p: Captioned by TC / “This seems to have been gathered mainly at Haddington (in perhaps 1859 &c): I know few of the figures; mournfully mark this I do (Monday night, 7 Octr 1869) T.C.” / “x” in TC’s hand indicates that he was unable to identify the figure) / this album includes 44 images
